title: Why Gil met no drugs in the West; drugs among his musicians
summary: Gil explains why he never saw pot in the West and says almost none of his band uses hard drugs or grass.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: I'm still paranoid enough because you know, I wasn't just introduced to pot you know, although I was introduced to it later in life comparitively speaking. Because it's only in about the last twenty years when I came to New York. I never had it in any of the places I lived in the West because the people that I was around, the people my mother was around and they were definitely not anybody native to the Country. I mean they were all foreigners really. There were no Indians or Mexicans or anybody who lived in the Country who do smoke pot and know how and have it. And take, mushrooms and and mescaline and all that. They know how to use it and...use it. sensibly. (VOICE FADES OUT).
Do you find because you know drugs are a major problem, or we don't say that now, for

ourselves, but maybe a hundred years from now when people listen to this there will be some perspective that they can gain from it, but since we do know the drug problem is a major one, now, I'm asking if you find it to be much of a problem with the musicians that you have to work with in these days?

No, I don't know anybody now who would dash out in the middle of a job (or something, terribly late because they have to write the scores. I don't think anybody in my band uses hard drugs. I don't think any of them smoke grass.

See, Oh the grass, you can usually, a lot of times you can tell a person by their character structure whether grass is good for them or not. Some people can't smoke grass because it would put them more where they already are in a sense, you know what I mean?

They are already in that kind of a thing, they are breathing pretty regularly and they are able to cope with the basic, basically with the situation. They understand the basic relationship of, basic relationship, basic condition of their relationship with people, you know.

Lots of people don't smoke grass. They have found that when they do it makes them very paranoid. It doesn't do for them what it's supposed to do. So I really, I don't think in my band I have any, one or two smoke grass I think, but really not much.
That's really quite amazing for today isn't it?
